titles.text: ✔ normal demo cleanup stops active runs, preserves history and excludes prefix/version lookalikes (20735.477741ms)
✔ committed messages push addresses, notification receipts preserve read and ACK semantics (337.055793ms)
✔ stopped, terminal, expired, disabled and cross-owner runs never receive notifications (30.787319ms)
✔ real Postgres: idle gateway presence drives dispatch, device selection and post-commit uninstall (7056.566293ms)
✔ owner revoke stops attributed work, revokes worker access, records once and preserves sibling credentials (531.433997ms)
✔ a receipt write fault rolls token, stop, lease and worker revocation back atomically (83.064655ms)
✔ a revocation waits for the admitted writer transaction, and later raw/ORM admissions all refuse (305.461835ms)
✔ the actual event route accepts before revoke and rejects the old token after a fresh request scope (473.280051ms)
✔ revocation while the real event handler waits for its body prevents the later write (1100.801054ms)
✔ terminating an admitted write connection rolls back both the write and authority lock (65.287647ms)
✔ a long poll loses token authority within its five-second database polling interval (2094.992032ms)
✔ with push, revocation ends a waiting long poll on its NOTIFY, long before any timer; a lost NOTIFY still fails it at the deadline (4131.93216ms)
✔ existing device removal still refuses live work, then records revocation without deleting history (110.296679ms)
✔ a device request is fenced by its first statement, with no check up front, and reads no device report it does not use (68.644857ms)
✔ one read of a device's runs finds its stops, messages and queued runs (4173.909858ms)
✔ the idle check answers in one statement, finds the same work and pending device commands, and refuses a revoked credential (335.365403ms)
✔ the same credential remains valid for its established heartbeat route (168.979538ms)
✔ own run renewal passes route authentication and reaches issuance once (126.139255ms)
✔ another device and another run remain refused before issuance (54.545079ms)
✔ an ended machine cannot obtain a new lease (17.035946ms)
✔ revoked cloud credentials remain refused (11.949622ms)
✔ a bound cloud device can renew its own subscription lease through the actual route (5446.853644ms)
✔ a heartbeat re-checks execution identities only when the harnesses change or the device comes back, and renews the leases of the runs it reports (18494.979363ms)
✔ runs poll reads current authority, ownership and results in one snapshot (221.240769ms)
✔ repos poll reads current authority, ownership and results in one snapshot (237.349346ms)
✔ initial claim repository handoff removes a real cloud repos request without increasing SQL, rows or response bytes (228.880722ms)
✔ every device route refuses a token revoked after authentication before it calls out or issues anything (19444.704686ms)
✔ a revocation waits for the burst in flight; the next burst answers 401 (2115.309283ms)
✔ between bursts (a wait, network IO) the fence is not held: a revocation goes through at once (1326.745777ms)
✔ a hung unit loses its fence after 10 s; the revocation then completes and the unit fails closed (4032.039767ms)
✔ when no fence connection can be had the request is refused with 503, never run unfenced (2370.899171ms)
✔ ten concurrent multi-statement device requests complete with three fence connections; fewer authorization transactions and round trips than one fence per statement (124.273202ms)
✔ desktop account context reads only the current browser owner's active local devices (483.453448ms)
✔ local setup owner view retains fresh session checks without reading unused devices (18.42917ms)
✔ owner token pagination preserves microsecond ordering and rejects foreign or malformed anchors (73.862027ms)
✔ registration grant is user-bound, expires, and has one concurrent winner (36.51574ms)
✔ registration grant consumption uses one PostgreSQL statement (4.247214ms)
✔ a failed credential insertion does not consume the enrollment grant (29.523957ms)
✔ daemon acceptance follows real local enrollment and owner routes without a cloud token binding (33.423668ms)
✔ online removal offers only uninstall, and its own receipt revokes credentials (14260.916953ms)
✔ unacknowledged uninstall expires after ten minutes; offline removal revokes immediately (24.119143ms)
✔ management queue is owner-scoped, serial and acknowledges only its device (21.167774ms)
✔ pending commands without receipts are one read and preserve current device removal state (9.155106ms)
✔ a fresh login cannot admit an old daemon, and updating cannot revive a revoked credential (34.621286ms)
✔ registration metadata cannot disguise an old daemon behind a current header (18.577932ms)

limitations: Database success is separate from whole-CI, Native SQL budgets and production/model/Replay acceptance.
Workflow conditional skipped steps are preserved independently of required Node-test skipped0.
Shards1/2/3 preserve optional CLI-approval artifact no-files warnings; shard4 artifact upload is in the original log. No artifact payload was downloaded or claimed verified.
Logs are official decoded UTF-8, including BOM and ANSI; no ZIP or server-raw-byte fidelity claim.
FFMPEG_GITHUB_TOKEN is masked in job logs but process-scope security is a separate source review; masking does not disprove access by dependency lifecycle processes.
